named-native-query.name: MarketPrice.ohlc
named-native-query.query:
SELECT item_blueprint_id,
coalesce( (Select m2.currentprice from marketprice m2 where m2.roundId = :startId and m2.item_blueprint_id = m.item_blueprint_id), (array_agg(currentPrice order by roundid ASC))[1]) as open,
max(currentprice) as high, min(currentprice) as low, (array_agg(currentprice order by roundid DESC))[1] as close FROM marketprice m WHERE roundid >= :startId AND roundid <= :endId GROUP BY item_blueprint_id
